entry.title: Stop paying OpenAI to transcribe your voice notes (My offline Telegram bot stack) 🎙️
entry.summary: Every tutorial on building an AI Telegram bot right now uses the exact same lazy architecture: User sends a voice message. Bot downloads the .ogg file. Bot sends the file to OpenAI's Whisper API. You get billed per minute of audio. This is fine if you are building a quick prototype.
